# Scripts (DeepInit)

- `validate.ts` is the content gate. It stops after grammar errors, then checks mandatory cores, route keys (each named and read by some content), ADR 0021 compounding (each later chapter patches an earlier payout), pacing, cap lines, ridge timing, attunement places against methods held at once (rule 74) and reachability by playing the real engine (`scripts/validate.ts:246-337`).
- Pacing constants: Foundation 480–780 s and Circulation by 600 s on `DIRECT_ROUTES`; the preference routes only under 1200 s; every timed record ≤180 s; every ridge route, from either reading, 720–1440 s after Foundation (`scripts/validate.ts:30-44`, `scripts/validate.ts:293-320`).
- `routes.ts` enforces no pace of its own; run directly it prints the openings and fails only when one misses Foundation (`scripts/routes.ts:467`). Attentive (direct) routes start the next pursuit instead of sitting out the auto-started Rest, and every route cuts timber only toward the next piece it still means to build.
- Route preferences hardcode content ids; stale ids surface as "names records content no longer has" (`scripts/validate.ts:328-330`).
- `browser-smoke.ts` (Playwright Chromium) writes screenshots and `smoke-results.json` into `playtest/` (`scripts/browser-smoke.ts:11`, `scripts/browser-smoke.ts:660`).
- `serve.ts` serves only four built files from `dist/` on 127.0.0.1:4173 (`scripts/serve.ts:4-14`).
